title: Ahab and Jezebel's Worship of Baal
description: Ahab, son of Omri, marries Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal from Sidon, and introduces the worship of Baal in Israel. He builds an altar for Baal in a temple of Baal in Samaria and makes an Asherah pole. Ahab does more to provoke the Lord's anger than all the kings of Israel before him.
